mission: Find timely, technically useful ideas that can be taught clearly in a 2-3 minute LinkedIn post and a short Medium article.

discoveryLane.label: Important new AI developments
discoveryLane.rule: Admit an off-list topic only when the development is materially important and can be explained with trustworthy evidence.

selectionRules: Prefer developments that materially change architecture, cost, performance, developer workflow, governance, or enterprise adoption.
Prefer topics that can be explained with one clear technical idea rather than broad news summaries.
Prioritize official documentation, release notes, engineering blogs, repositories, and primary announcements for factual claims.
Use practitioner posts and benchmarks as secondary evidence or structural inspiration, not as unquestioned truth.
Do not manufacture hands-on experience, benchmarks, customer results, or first-person claims.
Avoid posting merely because a topic is trending; it must teach something useful.

shape: what changed or what the concept is
